chat_hint_worktree_prefix: Agent will work in an isolated worktree of
chat_hint_worktree_note: Your working copy stays untouched — each task hands its work back as an agent/… branch.

mode_dialog_title: How should tasks use this folder?
mode_dialog_description: This decides how you get an agent's work back, and whether tasks on this folder can run at the same time.
mode_in_place_description: One task at a time. Changes appear in your working copy as the agent makes them, ready for you to keep working on.
mode_worktree_description: Tasks run at the same time without touching your working copy. Each one hands back an agent/… branch in this repo for you to review and merge.
mode_worktree_needs_git: This folder is not a git repository, so there is nowhere to put the branch. Pick a repository, or keep editing the folder directly.
mode_worktree_needs_server_upgrade: Your Enact server is too old to run tasks in parallel — it would quietly run them in this folder instead. Update the server, then switch this on.
mode_edit_tooltip: Change how tasks use this folder
mode_badge_worktree_tooltip: Tasks run at the same time in their own git worktree and hand back a branch. Your working copy is untouched.
toast_local_mode_update_failed: Could not update the execution mode
knowledge_section_description: Repos of documents agents read as context. Attach one to an agent in its own settings — a knowledge base bound to nobody is never read.

hosting.title: Code hosting connections
hosting.description: Credentials, network trust, and capability checks for GitHub and GitLab.
hosting.github_permissions: Required App permissions: Contents and Pull requests read/write; Checks and Commit statuses read.
hosting.webhook_allowlist: Allow this Enact webhook host/IP in GitLab Outbound requests:
hosting.empty_admin: Connect GitHub or GitLab before adding a managed repository.
hosting.empty_member: No code-hosting connection is configured. Ask a workspace admin.
hosting.gitlab_description: Configure API and Git HTTPS credentials separately. Secrets are encrypted and never returned.
hosting.ca_hint: Optional. Added to the system trust store for Server API and daemon Git; TLS verification stays enabled.
hosting.secret_note: Use a scoped service account with limited project membership and a rotation date.
hosting.webhook_secret_once: Copy this Webhook secret now. It cannot be viewed again.
hosting.webhook_events: Register Merge Request and Pipeline events in GitLab, then send a test delivery.
hosting.automation_description: Applies to GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests.
hosting.automation_show_hint: Display linked change requests on issues.
hosting.automation_link_hint: Match issue identifiers in title, branch, or closing keyword.
hosting.automation_close: Move task to done after merge
hosting.automation_close_hint: Requires a closing keyword and no other open linked change request.
hosting.automation_coauthor_hint: Add the Enact agent attribution trailer to commits.
hosting.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this code hosting connection? Connections in use by repositories cannot be disconnected.
hosting.migration_action: Choose the matching GitHub or GitLab connection in the repository picker. Pending repositories remain disabled and are never silently skipped.
hosting.status_dns: DNS: Server or daemon cannot resolve the configured host.
hosting.status_network: Network: check VPN, route, firewall and timeout.
hosting.status_tls: TLS: add the enterprise PEM CA or repair the certificate chain.
hosting.status_401: Credential: replace an expired or invalid token.
hosting.status_403: Authorization: check token scope and repository membership.
hosting.status_untested: Run the test; Git also requires an online daemon.
hosting.fixed_ref_hint: Branch, tag, or commit; default branch when empty
